note: Round 14, all: compose-rs at 3ac74a6 with every optimization (bench-rs -e optimizations all, its own hint session on), against Compose 1.12.1 (BOM 2026.09.00), interleaved; --runs 15 (startup), 3 traced runs of each scroll and animation scenario, speed; every run started at thermal status 0, battery <= 34 C and skin <= 35 C (--battery-limit 34 --skin-limit 35 --thermal-wait-limit 0), our apps stopped while waiting. Run right after the parity round.

d390_boost.about: The RenderThread's boost, computed from this run's traces: per run (scenario-subject-run), the boost picture of HWUI's counter alone (hwui_min, as render_boost), of compose-rs's own session's minimum (app_min; none at parity, its session off), of the higher of both sessions' active CPU votes (effective_votes: what the power HAL applies; HWUI's alone at parity), plus CPU time and work by thread kind over the measured window (13 s scrolling, 9 s animating), for scroll, animation, stress_scroll and stress_animation.

prefetch_slices.about: Item composition and prefetch work on the main thread, from this run's scroll and stress_scroll traces: per run (scenario-subject-run), for each slice name (compose-rs's prefetch sections and frame phases; Compose's lazy prefetch and recomposition sections), the number of slices from the stats' start, their wall time, the main thread's running time inside them, its work (ms on the fastest core at its highest frequency) and its running time on the little cores.

lazy_lists.about: compose-rs's lazy lists in this run's traces. runs: per scroll and stress_scroll run, from the stats' start, the count and total wall time (ms) of in-frame rounds (`compose-rs: recompose and layout again`), the frames holding one, text layouts inside a `compose-rs: frame`, prefetch compositions and measurements, draw-ahead steps, compose-rs frames and replays. first_frame: per traced start (feed, big, stress), the sections inside the first `compose-rs: frame` (count, total ms).

late_do_frames.about: doFrames starting more than 2 ms after their vsync, for both apps, per run (scenario-subject-run) of scroll, animation, stress_scroll and stress_animation, from the stats' start: do_frames, and per late doFrame its lateness, duration, the main thread's runnable and running time between the vsync and the doFrame (the rest: asleep, woken late), FrameTimeline's jank and present types, on_time_finish and margin_ms (the deadline less the frame's end); summary: counts and margins.

hwui_workers.about: HWUI's worker threads' (hwuiTask*) CPU time (ms) in each stress_animation trace (scenario-subject-run), from the stats' start (10 s).
